name: s81_rly_283_wn-rfp1-COMMIT
purpose: S81 die relay flow variant dsfd_rly_283_WN requested by the die (c26b GEN --rly-face-pins kit_requests: 753 instances, gain up to 103.8 um of pin-to-pin + wrap; VIS-ROM S81F-01): same body as the closed 283 standards (ot_s81_rly W 283 RSREG 1, one register stage, recipe 2, output pad HB1); i on W (283 M4 pins at 2 tracks = 27.2 um of the 30.24 face, as 283_WE), o on N (283 M5 pins at 2 tracks over 34.56, as 283_SN), ck/rs S

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_rly_283_WN u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_glue/ot_s81_rly.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_glue/dsfd_rly_masters_rfp.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81_rly_283_wn/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81_rly_283_wn/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81_rly_283_wn --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_rly_283_WN  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
